claims.claim: The overall score (OS) of ego vehicles is reduced by 16% relative to the leading baseline in ChatScene-generated scenarios.

claims.quote:
nificant relative reduction in the overall score, amounting to

claims.claim: After adversarial finetuning with ChatScene scenarios, the ego vehicle's collision rate is reduced by 51% compared with the original ego vehicle without finetuning.
claims.metric: collision rate reduction after adversarial finetuning
claims.condition: SafeBench; ego vehicle finetuned adversarially with ChatScene-generated scenes (first eight routes), tested on scenes from the last two routes; finetuning 500 epochs, learning rate 0.0001, best result over evaluations every 50 epochs
